title: XML API response → XML node, no Code
task: Build an n8n workflow that runs every morning at 07:00, fetches https://legacy.example.com/api/stock.xml (no authentication; the response is XML like <stock><item sku="A1" qty="3"/><item sku="B2" qty="9"/></stock>), and posts one Slack message to the channel #ops listing the SKUs whose qty is below 5. A Slack credential already exists in n8n.

assertions.label: HTTP Request carries a Why HTTP: note
every node wired to the trigger

notes: The legacy endpoint has no service node, so HTTP Request is right — with a Why HTTP: note.
